scene: Inside the bathhouse lobby, three departure docks lead out across the city.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a tiled bathhouse transit lobby along one floor line. At far left, a wooden koi boat floats in an indoor canal. The grandfather stands with his bicycle and plant crate at centre. Overhead, a mossy garden tram rests on an arched high track. On far right sits the yellow bento express.
shown: a sleek carved wooden koi boat bobbing in the water dock at far left
a green moss-roofed garden tram waiting at an open platform archway up high
a gleaming yellow bullet-nosed bento express train idling at a ticket gate on far right
